question: Which among the following is an international level professional auto racing sport?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Formula One.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Formula One is an international level professional auto racing sport that involves drivers competing in high-performance cars on circuits around the world.**
 
• The sport is watched by millions of fans globally and is considered the pinnacle of motorsport.
 
• Formula One is a single-seater auto racing sport that involves drivers competing in high-performance cars on circuits around the world.
 
• **It is considered the pinnacle of motorsport and is watched by millions of fans globally.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The **Super Bowl** is an **American football championship game** played annually in the United States.
